readme.text: # Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake Archipelago Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake implementation for the [Archipelago multiworld randomizer](https://archipelago.gg/). ## Setup Guide 1. If you plan to host a room, make sure you have [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases) 0.6.7+ installed 2. Download the latest version of [DQ3AP](https://github.com/ZigzagAwaka/DQ3AP/releases) 3. Place `Game-WindowsNoEditor_P_DQ3AP.pak` in `Game/Content/Paks` in the game folder 4. Place `DQ3AP.asi`, `dsound.dll`, `libAPCpp.dll`, `libstdc++-6.dll`, `libgcc_s_seh-1.dll` and `libwinpthread-1.dll` in `Game/Binaries/Win64` in the game folder, next to the executable 5. If playing on a Linux computer, add `WINEDLLOVERRIDES="dsound.dll=n,b" %command%` in the game's launch options on Steam (no need to do that on Windows!) 6. For generating a world, place or install `dq3.apworld` in the `custom_worlds` folder of your Archipelago installation 7. For configuring your randomized game, select `Generate Template Options` in the Archipelago Launcher to create a `Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake.yaml` that you can edit to your liking (make sure to have the apworld installed before doing this) 8. You can now [generate a world](https://archipelago.gg/tutorial/Archipelago/setup_en#on-your-local-installation) and play! After playing the mod, if you later want to play in vanilla again you will need to at least uninstall/remove the following files: `DQ3AP.asi` and `Game-WindowsNoEditor_P_DQ3AP.pak`. ## Connecting to a hosted room When the setup is finished, you can open the game on Steam to see a new separate DQ3AP console appearing alongside the game. Use it to connect to a room : - Type `/connect [password]` into the console with valid parameters *(example: /connect archipelago.gg:12345 Player1)* - You can connect anytime you want, before or after loading your game file. But make sure to be connected before checking a new location in the game ! *Tips:* If you have some spaces in your player name or password, use quotes! *(example: "Player name")* *Tips 2:* If you stop the game and come back later, try `/reconnect` to try to reconnect faster! *(if the current room still has the same port)* ## Useful informations ### What does randomization do to this game ? In Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake, all obtainable items (usable items, equipment, gold, ...) are shuffled into the multiworld. From chests to barrels, pots, bookshelves and important NPC events, you'll have a great time figuring out a route to complete your goal ! Options to choose which locations are randomized, excluded or vanilla are available for those who want to configure some things before playing. ### What is the goal of the game when randomized ? You have multiple options to set the goal of the game, among these: - Defeat **Zoma**, the final boss of the game - Defeat the **Grand Dragon**, the final boss of the postgame - Find all **mini medals** - Find all **mini medals**, with postgame locations included - Defeat **Baramos**, for shorter games - Find all **mini medals**, then defeat **Zoma** - Find all **mini medals**, then defeat the **Grand Dragon** ### What versions of the game are supported ? The only supported version is the Steam/PC release of `Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake`. ### Which items can be in another player's world ? All obtainable items (equipments, keys, usable items, ...) can be placed in other players' worlds. In short, items in containers, given by NPCs, found in shiny spots and sold in shops are all randomized. Some "in game events" are also treated as items for Archipelago such as getting the Ship, Ramia and traps, this means those can also be obtained like items if they are randomized. Overworld maps, medals rewards, arena rewards and enemy drops are not randomized but some of these may be changed in the future. ### What does another world's item look like in the game ? Multiworld items appear as an **Archipelago medal** sprite when you collect them. The game will also display a message when you get it. Collecting this item will trigger the Archipelago server to send back the corresponding item to the correct player. And if it was one of your own items, the server will then send it to you *[items are all remotely implemented for now, you will still find Archipelago medals for your own items then receive those as if someone else was giving it to you]*. ### When the player receives an item, what happens ? The game will cache the received items then give them all to the player when one of the following events happens : - The player enters or exits an area, house, dungeon, or village (that does not have any special events happening at the same time) by a scene transition - The player successfully defeats an enemy (but not a Cannibox/Mimic/Pandora's Box as those are traps !) - The player checks a container that gives an Archipelago check (chests, barrels, pots, ...) - The player talks to the Inn keeper of any village with any dialogue options: Stay Overnight, Rest Awhile or Cancel - The player talks to a Priest of any location by loading a save file from the title screen - The player uses some specific field spells/abilities Once items are obtained, the game will display the item's sprite with a message to show what's been received. *Tips:* When receiving multiple items, it's possible to hold the ingame speedup button in order to increase the speed of the animation! ### Archipelago is all about playing with multiple worlds/players, but can I play in singleplayer ? You can play in singleplayer by generating a world with only this game, then connect and play as usual (you still need to be online for it to work). ### Can I go back to previously explored areas ? If you don't want to walk back to previous areas, then you can use Zoom to warp to any previously explored areas. This is the same as in a regular non-randomized game. Also, Zoom, among other field spells/abilities, is unlocked from the start of the game so you can use it right away. ### What about saving ? **Make sure to always save the game before turning it off !** If you check a location then turn off the game without saving (or reloading a previous save) then the location will be available to be checked again but actually checking it will have no effect since it was already registered by the Archipelago server. If you receive an item then turn off the game without saving (or reloading a previous save) then the item will be lost (use Archipelago server admin commands to get it back). The game already perform some auto saves automatically when you receive an item, so you can also reload the latest auto save if you need it. ### Is there a location tracker available ? For this, you can use [Universal Tracker](https://github.com/FarisTheAncient/Archipelago/releases?q=Tracker). Just make sure you have correctly installed the apworld file before using this tracker. ### What about other mods compatibility ? Most other mods should be compatible, but if you want to learn more about this please check [this document here](https://github.com/ZigzagAwaka/DQ3AP/blob/main/ModsCompatibility.md) describing mods compatibility in details. This document also lists some other mods you can install to have a better experience at playing the game with Archipelago. ### What other modifications are being made to the game ? Other modifications were implemented to nicely integrate Archipelago, among these some important changes to scenes and items. Please check [this document here](https://github.com/ZigzagAwaka/DQ3AP/blob/main/GameModifications.md) if you want to learn about those edits. ## Feedbacks and issues You can report anything in the `Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake` post in the `custom-games` channel of the [Archipelago discord server](https://discord.gg/archipelago) or post a new issue on github. ## Useful ressources and special thanks - [Guide and Walkthrough by FranckKnight](https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/xbox-series-x/466974-dragon-quest-iii-hd-2d-remake/faqs/81601/introduction) - [Game Interactive Maps by th3blackb3rry](https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/pc/466975-dragon-quest-iii-hd-2d-remake/faqs) - [APCpp Library: used by the client mod](https://github.com/N00byKing/APCpp) - [@mike9k1: for useful modding advices](https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/mike9k1) - [@xyphire: for making the Archipelago item texture](https://interweb.xyphire.tv) - [@mastermarz: for helping at figuring out the logic in some locations](https://www.twitch.tv/mastermarz) - [@seraphin_eveles: for good support and testing](https://www.twitch.tv/seraphin_eveles)

notes.text:
This is a pretty big quality of life update !
First of all, it adds Shop sanity as an option in the apworld, so if turned on, you will be able to get random items checks by buying items in all the shops in the game. Be prepared tho because there is a lot of them !
And also, this update improve the overall experience of playing the game with DQ3AP (there was a lot of small changes).

- Added `shop_sanity` option, this can be activated to enable the randomization of items in shops
- Added `zoma_medals` and `grand_dragon_medals` as possible victory goal options, those are a mix of the medals goal and their respective defeat boss event where collecting all mini medals will be required to advance towards the goal
- Added `required_medals_amount` option, this can be used to change the amount of required mini medals that needs to be aquired for any chosen victory goals involving finding medals
- Added `trials_edits` option with 3 options: none, fast(default) and very fast, this was made to simplify the action of completing the trials in the Temple of Trials at the end of the postgame, this option will automatically skip a specific amount of trials upon completing the east trial to speedup seeds that have a postgame related victory goal
- Added new items (those that are exclusive to shops) that can be randomly generated in the item pool when playing with one or more of the following options: `shop_sanity`, `shiny_spots_sanity`, `random_filler_item_pool`
- Updated the forced quantity of filler items generated in the item pool if `shiny_spots_sanity` is enabled and `random_filler_item_pool` is disabled, this has the effect of generating a more balanced item pool in this specific case
- Updated Fading Jenny effect and logic: this item is now unique and can be used without losing it, it is now shuffled in the item pool and is required to access Edina Castle
- Updated Mod Rod effect and logic: this item is now unusable and is only required to be given to the Old Man in Grimland. The second Mod Rod (obtained in the Monster Arena) has been modified and renamed to the Modmore Rod, this one is now shuffled in the item pool and is usable and required to access the shop in Faerie Village (if shops are randomized) and to complete the east trial in the Temple of Trials (if the victory goal is postgame related)
- Updated getting items from outside of containers to now happen inside of "ingame events", this means it's now possible to speedup the getting items animation when holding the speedup event button
- Updated the receiving of the Ship and Ramia so those are now teleported automatically near Aliahan if you don't have access to their spawn locations yet (requires a map reload)
- Updated the event for receiving items so it will now be ignored until the game's introduction is finished (when the Hero's mother leaves you to go talk to the king)
- Updated the classification of some items that were considered filler items but are now useful items
- Updated the ingame rarity of some items so that filler items are no longer considered rare, meaning those will not play the rare item get animation when being received
- Completely reworked how the reward from the Trader in Alltrades Abbey is obtained: the reward is now being given by the pepper Merchant in Baharata directly after saving him in Kidnapper's Cave (as it should have been fixed in 0.4.0 but it was not, logic is the same)
- Removed the Grand Medal in the item pool and the check for defeating the Grand Dragon as those were impossible to get before the server release upon completing the victory goal (defeating the Grand Dragon is still required to complete a postgame victory goal)
- Other minor changes and fixes

If updating from v0.4.1 : replace `DQ3AP.asi`, `Game-WindowsNoEditor_P_DQ3AP.pak` and `dq3.apworld` by the new versions.
Or else, follow the setup [here](https://github.com/ZigzagAwaka/DQ3AP#setup-guide).
